t: What Building Envelope Performance Database Is All About
title: What Building Envelope Performance Database Is All About
description: The building envelope separates inside from outside: insulation (R-value), air barrier (blower-door tested, <3 ACH50 for tight homes), vapor control, and water management (drainage planes). Failures are moisture: 90% of envelope failures are water. The perfect wall — control layers in order — is building science's core diagram. Test with the blower door; verify with the infrared camera. This database is the complete envelope record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
